state: Goal `core-time-datetime`: `Core\Time\DateTime::date` and `::dayOfYear` have every feature proof on disk except their perf figure, which the driver's sweep records. `Core\Time\DateTime` has its class card (`DATETIME_CARD` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/time.rs`), so no member of the class owes `help` any more. The Rust tests `datetime_date_is_the_day_in_the_values_own_zone` and `datetime_day_of_year_is_one_based_and_read_in_the_values_own_zone` sit at the end of the `time.rs` test module, with the helpers `datetime_date` and `datetime_day_of_year`. They show the shape for the next members: `datetime_built(&Zoned)` builds the receiver, and `nvs_runtime::call` drives the member. Nothing is blocked.
